title: ADV Innovations: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Client File. Keep it, take Cobalt Crystal, or re-roll. Deep navy and dark are fixed either way.

options.label: The Client File
options.lineage: private-bank client dossiers, clothbound archive files with index tabs
options.thesis: The site is one open client file: every service a tab, every inquiry a new file we sort for you.
options.viewport: An open navy dossier fills the screen: debossed headline, the first index card already asking 'Where do the hours go?', the four services as tabs on the right edge.
options.risk: Turns bureaucratic or skeuomorphic-cute if the cloth and cards are rendered timidly or too literally.

raised.raise: The inquiry keeps a strict numbered step column (01 / 06) like a fold sequence, never a long scroll of fields.
One unbroken progress rail with a 'now' mark runs under every inquiry card.
The hero is one held moment: no carousel, no cycling cards; the file is already open.
An inquiry has a named state vocabulary the visitor sees: draft, filed, sorted, answered.

options.label: Cobalt Crystal
options.lineage: Bohemian cut cobalt glass (Prague's own luxury craft)
options.thesis: ADV as a block of cut cobalt glass: light passes through precise 75° facets, the cut of our A.
options.viewport: One faceted cobalt slab centre stage with the A cut through it, a slow light sweep across the facets; headline low left, inquiry and work actions right, the four services as a band along the bottom.
options.risk: Closest to where most dark premium sites land (glass, glow); only reads luxury if the refraction is real WebGL craft, not CSS gradients.

options.label: Orizuru Fold Sequence
options.thesis: One sheet folded in numbered steps into a finished form.
options.viewport: A vermilion sheet mid-fold beside a numbered step column.
options.case: Fuses poorly: vermilion craft paper fights the deep-navy brief and SME owners don't see themselves in it.
options.kept: Strict numbered step column for the inquiry.
options.risk: Reads as a craft studio, not an automation company.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Sixteen steps under a running chase light.
options.viewport: A sixteen-key step row as the page's one line.
options.case: Fuses partly (steps map to the inquiry) but candy keys contradict premium navy; loses both axes.
options.kept: One unbroken progress rail with a 'now' mark.

options.label: Wuxia Painted Hoarding
options.thesis: A single held moment at the top of a leap.
options.viewport: A frozen leap with a vertical painted title.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cinematic drama misreads an organised, accountable supplier.
options.kept: The hero as one held moment, no carousel.

options.label: Chromatophore Skin
options.thesis: A surface that changes state as signals travel across it.
options.viewport: A living textile reacting to context.
options.case: Fuses poorly: organic and uncanny where the brief asks for precise and premium.
options.kept: A named, visible state vocabulary for each inquiry.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: Identity as a decoratable miniature room.
options.viewport: An isometric pastel room with a visitor counter.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful pastel nostalgia contradicts both the navy brief and B2B trust.

options.label: Gyaru Magazine Density
options.thesis: Every item on the page labelled with a call-out.
options.viewport: A packed spread of annotated figures.
options.case: Fuses poorly: density and glitter are the opposite of premium calm.
options.kept: The courage to label specifics (each service lists the exact tasks it handles).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark premium tech-company site (Linear, Mercury) executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline, two buttons, a product screenshot rising from below, services in a card row.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dark agency site by design.
